_comment: European pack: programmes open to researchers in EU member states and associated countries. Each source says how the scan reads it. 'url' is where the scan starts; the scan follows links from there.
label: European Union

sources.label: EU Funding & Tenders portal
sources.how: Search calls for proposals with status Open and Forthcoming. Calls are split into topics: one topic is one call record. Restrict to the user's opportunity types (for example ERC and MSCA for fellowships) and keywords from the profile's research areas.

sources.label: EURAXESS funding database
sources.how: Open the funding search from this page (the national EURAXESS portals have the same search under /funding/search). Filter by the user's countries, career stage and research field. Many entries point to national schemes: follow the link to the funder's own page and keep that page as the main link.
